automated_findings.L1_numeric_recompute: all published L1 checks pass; this does not establish cross-section anatomical meaning

implemented: d(log(area))/ds on each contiguous valid run, with no derivative across gaps or branches
upstream/downstream minimum-area ratio and distance in a 20 mm same-segment valid window
wall-area interpolation only when both bracketing sections are valid
P6 shift ±1 mm, tilt ±5 deg and half point-cloud density probes
along_path_fields.risk: A wrong but smooth contour contaminates slope and context descriptors over neighboring stations; these descriptors are diagnostic and must not be used to auto-approve a whole run.
along_path_fields.recommended_low_cost_gate: Flag a run when area ratio to a robust local median (3-station window) exceeds 2, when signed dlogA/ds exceeds the train-cohort 99.5th percentile, or when a P6 perturbation changes area >50%; merge contiguous flags into one review interval instead of one flag per station.

flag_counts_from_existing_screen.interpretation: These are triage signals, not independent failures; overlap is expected and should be collapsed by case plus contiguous station interval.

dV_ds.reason: Nearest-atlas s is a projected/discrete coordinate. Volume per s bin is dV/ds = integral(1/|grad s|) dA under a coarea interpretation; curvature, oblique planes, aneurysm sacs and branch overlap alter the factor.
dV_ds.use: Strong inconsistency ranking when the contour and volume density disagree by a large factor; never a hard physical inequality.

Rmis_ratio.reason: Rmis is a centerline/atlas local radius, not a guaranteed inscribed radius of the reconstructed polygon. A/(pi*Rmis^2)>3 is physically possible in aneurysm/elliptic sections and has no upper bound.
Rmis_ratio.safe_rule: A/(pi*Rmis^2)<~0.85 is a strong contradiction only after confirming Rmis and station alignment; high values rank for visual review but do not reject.

nonstar.reason: A simple non-star-shaped section can be a valid concave lumen. It becomes a compliance concern only with self-intersection, multiple disconnected contours, a centerline outside the selected lumen, or instability under small plane perturbation.
nonstar.safe_rule: Keep nonstar as a weak flag; promote only when paired with self-intersection/multiple-contour/centerline-outside/P6 instability.

slope.reason: log_area_slopes uses np.gradient on contiguous valid samples and does not bridge gaps, but edge derivatives are noisier and any contour error propagates to adjacent values.
slope.safe_rule: Report robust window slopes or median slope over 3–5 stations; do not threshold a single edge derivative.

bifurcation_localization.why: bifurcation_review marks no persistent two-contour transition; choose whether to accept inherited centerline segment endpoint or inspect the wall ridge manually

CIA_band_outliers.why: hard-band outliers can be real anatomy or a segment endpoint error; only a human can decide the intended CIA extent

centerline_inside_or_surface_integrity.cases: Use audit_summary.md quality-review list; 6 have nonzero outside-core points and 4 have an unclosed reference surface.
centerline_inside_or_surface_integrity.why: caps are added for the inside audit only; this is a source-surface integrity question, not a contour algorithm pass/fail

P6_visual_review.priority: Keep the existing v1.3 stability list; rank-3 ZHANG_XIU_ZHEN has perturbed_gate=false and therefore is automatically contained. The remaining large-change variants need visual confirmation only if their contours are to be used for training.
P6_visual_review.why: P6 samples only 21 sections per case and does not recompute whole-branch slope/context/wall mapping

auto_pass: closed non-self-intersecting contour with centerline inside
stable local area and no strong projected-volume contradiction
auto_review: paired dV/ds disagreement plus adjacent jump
P6 area change >50% with both gates true
centerline outside or unclosed source surface
human_only: CIA endpoint and bifurcation location when no persistent transition
whether a true aneurysm sac/concavity should be accepted
